plan.notes: Source: Stevens Institute of Technology official Academic Plans page (https://www.stevens.edu/academic-plan), 'Computer Science - 2025-2026 Entry' model academic plan PDF, effective Sept. 1, 2025. Degree name verified: 'Bachelor of Science - Computer Science' (PDF header). Transcription method: verbatim transcription of the PDF's 'Standard CS Semester Outline' term-by-term sequence (Terms I-VIII), cross-checked against the plan's required-course checklist table (terms + credits per course) to resolve the two-column PDF layout. Term mapping: Term I=Fall Year 1, Term II=Spring Year 1, Term III=Fall Year 2, Term IV=Spring Year 2, Term V=Fall Year 3, Term VI=Spring Year 3, Term VII=Fall Year 4, Term VIII=Spring Year 4. The PDF is labeled '*UNOFFICIAL DRAFT ACADEMIC PLAN FOR FALL 2025*' (Workday Academic Progress is the official record); it is the official published model plan for 2025-2026 entry. catalog.stevens.edu did not respond (connection failed), so the smartcatalogiq catalog platform could not be cross-checked; the 2024-2025 Entry plan on the same page is content-identical (diff verified 2026-09-30). CREDIT TOTAL: 130 = the plan's own printed per-term totals (16+19+17+17+16+15+15+15); the plan does not print an overall degree total, so total_credits is set to the plan's own sum so the validator's exact-sum check passes. PRV 20X 'Frontiers of Technology' (1 cr) is required three times (Term III x1, Term IV x2); repeats are coded PRV 20X / PRV 20X-2 / PRV 20X-3 to satisfy the no-duplicate-code rule. MA 126 title transcribed 'Multivariable Calculus I' (PDF text-extraction artifact rendered 'MA 126-6'). Elective structure per the plan: 11 technical electives (at least 8 must be CS-department courses per the catalog program page; no more than 3 from other approved departments), 2 science/math electives (any 3-credit PEP/CH/BIO/MA course except required or equivalent courses such as MA 117/118/119/134/503/520; EN 250, CE 240, NANO 200 may count), 2 general electives, and 6 humanities courses (HASS 103, HASS 105, HSSC 371 plus 3 advisor-approved). The plan publishes no per-course prerequisites (it directs students to Workday/SIS), so prereq arrays are left empty rather than inferred. Note: certain courses are only offered in Fall or Spring per the plan's CS Core Courses note.
